City Manager's Proposed FY14/15 Operating Budget and FY14/15 and FY15/16 Capital Improvement Budget and the six-year Financial Plan. Contact Person: Finance Director Nash
This report is the final of three related to the Proposed FY14/15 Operating and Capital budgets and six year Financial Plan presented to the City Council for their discussion and direction to staff. In this budget report, staff recommends that the City Council provide: 1) a motion to approve City Council intent motions identified during the May 14th and May 21st budget meetings and incorporate these actions into the proposed FY14/15 Operating Budget and FY14/15 and FY15/16 Capital Improvement Budget; 2) approval of the Financial Plan for FY14/15 to FY18/19 Operating and Capital Budgets (Scenario 5 from the May 21, 2014 budget report); and 3) funding in the FY14/15 Operating Budget, contingent upon FY13/14 Operating Budget anticipated year-end savings, for the Encinitas Business Chambers at $20,000, the San Diego North Economic Development Council at $5,000, and the City's FaÃ§ade Grant program at $40,000.
2014-05-28 Item 10A - Operating Budget Report

Consideration and possible adoption of a purchase and sale agreement and joint escrow instructions for the possible purchase of the former Pacific View School site (608 Third Street, Encinitas, California (APN 258-115-122))
1) Approve the Agreement in substantial form subject to the final review and approval of the City Manager and City Attorney; 2) Direct the Mayor to execute the Agreement; 3) Direct the City Manager and City Attorney to take any action necessary and appropriate to implement the Agreement, including preparing and executing related documents or agreements; and 4) Direct the City Manager (via the City Clerk) to agendize the Planning Commission's review of the potential purchase for consistency with the General Plan pursuant to Government Code Section 65402.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
